display.purpose: Single-line desktop heading clamp(36px,4.3vw,62px); responsive mobile wrapping.

depth.artMaterial: Shallow 2.5D satin faces, gentle bevel, narrow edge light, soft contact shading; no chrome or mirror gloss, no purely flat vector substitute.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Fill hover and scale(.98) on active; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: beam-travel
motion.purpose: CSS light travels translateY(5%) to translateY(50%), opacity .75–1. Even planes use12s; every third14s; each plane has a sequential -1.35s phase offset.

motion.name: viewpoint
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer offsets max 17px/12px, plus bounded .13× hero scroll displacement. Disabled when paused or reduced motion.

motion.name: preview-switch
motion.purpose: Opacity and 8px continuity on feature switching; hidden mounted panes retain input. Disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: edge-breathe
motion.purpose: One-pixel edge light changes opacity .3 to .85. Grain is static SVG turbulence, not animated.

extensions.motionControl: Pause light sweeps and edge breathing on explicit pause, document hidden, or hero outside the welcome scroll viewport. Reduced motion disables animation and smooth scrolling, leaves a static light treatment, and hides the pause control.
extensions.heroGeometry: Twelve CSS diagonal planes, -42deg rotation, 14px desktop/10px mobile gaps, varied lengths and sequential -1.35s light phases. Violet-dominant with a sparse cool seam. Static noise affects light alpha. Backdrop extends behind the compact product window.

narrative.overview: Near-black space, large white type, violet architectural light, and restrained translucent panels frame a hands-on product introduction. Pink and cyan distinguish the other minds. Artwork has shallow 2.5D satin depth, broad graphic faces, narrow edge lighting, and soft grounded shading. The confirmed material direction excludes chrome and mirror gloss; it also excludes completely flat vector treatment.
keyCharacteristics: Black breathing room around bright editorial type.
Independently animated CSS hero light planes and original TimeMachine artwork.
Functional, clearly labeled local demos inside restrained dark panels.
